sources: https://www.roverpass.com/c/west-branch-secret-campground-and-rv-park-west-branch-mi/booking (RoverPass booking API: park record, rates and cart for 2027-06-08 and 2027-06-12)

values.note: RoverPass quotes, 1 night: back-in water/electric site (20, 30 or 50 amp) $35 on a June 2027 Tuesday, $45 on a Saturday; pull-through $57 both nights; water-only RV site $35; tent site $30. No platform or processing fee in the cart. One rate for everyone (no county-resident rate). Cancellation over 30 days out refunded less a $5 fee.

hookups.source: http://www.westbranchrvpark.com/ ('RV sites are now serviced with 20/30/50 amp service') + RoverPass rates ('50 Amp RV Sites with Water'; 14 of the 36 bookable RV sites list 50 amps), read 2026-10-22

values.note: On a June 2027 date RoverPass offered 36 RV sites and 6 tent sites; per-site maximums run 24 to 63 ft, 33 of the 36 taking 25 ft or more.

sites.source: RoverPass booking API (sitesCountByTypeDuring; sitesAvailableDuring per-site maxLength; '... (Pull Through)' rates), read 2026-10-22

season.source: http://www.westbranchrvpark.com/ ('We are open May 1st until October 31st') + RoverPass closeSeasonDates (Nov 1 - Apr 30 each year), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: http://www.westbranchrvpark.com/ ('paved access directly to the bathhouse') + https://www.ocmi.us/wp-content/uploads/Parks-RV-Park.pdf ('Hot Showers') + RoverPass rule 'Dump Station' ('free of charge to our campers ... not camping at our park, it will be a $10 charge'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online through RoverPass (instant booking, site chosen by the guest), up to 10 months ahead; linked from the park's own site. Daily, monthly and seasonal sites. Tent stays limited to 14 consecutive nights.

booking.source: http://www.westbranchrvpark.com/ ('CLICK HERE!! TO MAKE YOUR RESERVATIONS ONLINE!' -> RoverPass) + RoverPass park record (isBookable true, isRequest false, advancedMonths 10, canChooseSite true), read 2026-10-22

note: Ogemaw County park (originally West Branch Township's, leased to the county for 99 years), now run as West Branch Secret Campground and RV Park: wooded sites 1.5 mi north of I-75 exit 212, close to downtown West Branch and the outlet mall. --Claude
summary: The county page links only a 2016 flyer; the park's own current site is westbranchrvpark.com, booked on a claimed RoverPass listing: $35 midweek / $45 Saturday back-in, $57 pull-through (June 2027), 20/30/50-amp with water, May 1 - Oct 31, showers and dump station. Google Maps: West Branch RV Park, 2370 I-75BL, open, 4.6 stars / 113 reviews, phone 989-345-3295 (matches). Site count 53 (note prose) left alone: RoverPass showed 36 RV + 6 tent sites bookable on a June date. Note cleaned.
flags: Website: give the park's own site http://www.westbranchrvpark.com/ (booking: https://www.roverpass.com/c/west-branch-secret-campground-and-rv-park-west-branch-mi/booking); the stored https://www.ocmi.us/parks-and-recreation/ is the county's general parks page, whose only park item is a 2016 flyer (https://www.ocmi.us/wp-content/uploads/Parks-RV-Park.pdf).
Name: the park now publishes itself as 'West Branch Secret Campground and RV Park' (its website, RoverPass); Google still lists 'West Branch RV Park'.

Ownership check: the current website and RoverPass listing say nothing of Ogemaw County (reservations go to reservations@westbranchrvpark.com), so the park may now be run by a private operator or concessionaire; the county page still lists it. Ownership left 'local'.
